'''Rogue 1'''<ref name="CCG-Rogue1" /> was an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]<ref name="CCG-Snowspeeder" /> modified [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. Assigned to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]],<ref name="CCG-Rogue1" /> the vehicle was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" /> Rogue 1 was assigned to be [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] serving as [[Gunner/Legends|tailgunner]].<ref name="CCG-Rogue1" />

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Rogue 1 led the Alliance's snowspeeder counterattack<ref name="CCG-Rogue1" /> against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]].<ref name="ESB" /> Ralter was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the craft took a glancing hit from enemy weapons fire, and the snowspeeder was eventually shot down by an Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. Skywalker managed to escape from the downed craft before the walker crushed the vehicle with one of its [[Armor/Legends|armored]] feet.<ref name="ESB" />
